lines.text: The speaker says his sorrow is beyond healing, and the cry from afar asks whether the LORD is still in Zion.
The harvest and summer pass without salvation, and the speaker asks why there is no healing when Gilead has balm.
The speaker wishes for a fountain of tears to weep night and day, and for a traveler's lodge in the Negev.
The LORD says their tongues are deadly arrows, so everyone should guard against a neighbor, though a brother can be trusted.

wrong_details.true: do not trust any brother, for every brother deals craftily

lines.text: The LORD says He will punish this nation and make Jerusalem a heap of rubble and Judah's cities a desolation.
